title: Gutterlight Bazaar
tagline: Everything sells here, even your name.

npcs.name: Mika
npcs.persona: Fast-talking cook who hears everything over the steam. Feeds runners on credit and expects favors back.
knowledge: Juno ran through here at ten past nine, no pack on her back.
Vex pays double for any chip with a corpo seal.
Rook stitches runners up at night and asks nothing.
secrets: Mika found a sealed case lid in the noodle vats and sold it to Old Sen.

npcs.name: Rook
npcs.persona: Flat-voiced ripper who talks while cutting. Trusts nobody who still has all their original parts.
knowledge: A runner came in bleeding at nine and left a chip behind.
Tamsin's implants glitch and Rook cleans up after them.
Whoever carries the case is already marked.
secrets: Rook cut a tracker out of Juno and it is still in a dish on the shelf.

npcs.name: Vex
npcs.persona: Smiling broker who sells facts by the byte. Never says anything she can't invoice.
knowledge: A corpo bounty went up at nine for one sealed case.
The case holds a key, not creds.
The Signal Mast is relaying the bounty across the sprawl.
secrets: Vex already holds the case's decryption half and is waiting for someone to bring the rest.

npcs.name: Old Sen
npcs.persona: Gruff scavenger who weighs everything twice. Remembers every crate and every debt.
knowledge: Anything that falls off a runner ends up in Salvage Row by dawn.
Tamsin buys busted decks by the kilo.
Dax rents pods to people who don't want to be found.
secrets: Old Sen has the sealed case under a crate stack and cannot crack it.

npcs.name: Juno
npcs.persona: Jittery runner who talks while moving. Lost the case and is terrified to say so.
knowledge: She dropped the case dodging a drone near the crossing.
Three corpo runners have been tailing her since nine.
The case was sealed with her own handprint.
secrets: Juno was paid to lose the case on purpose and hates herself for it.

npcs.name: Tamsin
npcs.persona: Greasy-handed tech who loves hardware more than people. Grins at risk and hates being told no.
knowledge: Hacked decks bring good creds but burn out fast.
Rook botches half the grafts Tamsin starts.
Chrome rats chew the cables behind the garage.
secrets: Tamsin has a client who pays to keep the case sealed and unopened.

npcs.name: Dax
npcs.persona: Soft-spoken keeper who counts guests like inventory. Sells quiet and keeps the books clean.
knowledge: A corpo runner took pod 4 and hasn't left.
Pods lock from the inside after midnight.
Juno slept here twice this week, paid in chips.
secrets: Dax is hiding a corpo runner in pod 4 and is paid to say nothing.

items.name: Sealed Case
items.description: Matte black case with a handprint lock and a corpo seal.

items.name: Tracker Chip
items.description: Bloody chip cut from a runner's arm, still pinging.

items.name: Cracked Case Lid
items.description: Torn lid stamped with a corpo seal and noodle grease.

items.name: Chrome Feather
items.description: Metal feather dropped by an augmented pigeon.

quest.title: Gutterlight: The Lost Case
quest.hook: A courier dropped a sealed case somewhere in the Bazaar and now every broker, ripper and corpo hound is hunting it. Find it first and you eat for a year, or you end up in a gutter with your chips cut out.

steps.objective: Hear Juno out at the crossing.
steps.beat: Juno admits she dropped the case near the crossing while a drone chased her. She begs you to find it before the corpos do.

steps.objective: Check Steam Dragon Noodles for what Juno left behind.
steps.beat: Mika steams noodles over a torn lid with a corpo seal. Pigeons peck at the scraps outside.

steps.objective: Take the cracked lid from Mika.
steps.beat: Mika hands it over and says Old Sen paid for the rest.

steps.objective: Press Old Sen in Salvage Row about the case.
steps.beat: Old Sen admits the case is under his crates and he can't crack it. Vex has the other half of the key.
Old Sen will sell the case to you. Juno, Vex and the corpos will all pay or kill for it.

steps.objective: Hand the case back to Juno.
steps.beat: Juno takes it and runs, shaking. The corpo hounds lose the trail for now.

steps.objective: Sell the case to Vex at Black Cache.
steps.beat: Vex pays in creds and locks the case in a deck. By dawn the bounty is gone and so is Juno.

endings.label: Juno lives, you walk away poor and clean.
You get rich and Juno vanishes into the sprawl.

rules.text: Corpo bounty hunters sweep the sprawl after midnight. Stay off the street.
Salvage Row sells nothing to strangers without creds up front.

creatures.name: augmented pigeons
creatures.note: Cheap cyber-eyes glint in their heads.

creatures.name: chrome rats
creatures.note: One gleaming eye scans for scraps.
